reason: The cited README explicitly says the tool executes arbitrary JavaScript in the Playwright server process and is “RCE-equivalent,” and the parameters allow inline code or loading code from a file. That directly supports HOSTEXEC. Under the provided label definitions, HOSTEXEC implies the other three effects as well: such host code execution can access non-public host/workspace data, send agent-supplied data to attacker-readable destinations, and produce attacker-controllable returned content.
